source_facts.fact: Documented streaming mutations Append/Clear only; not a general Markdown editor.
ObservableStringBuilder is not thread-safe and must be updated on Avalonia UI thread.

SourceSpan is a source range within a version, not edit-stable identity. LayoutText uses block-local UTF-16 coordinates; embedded controls occupy U+FFFC with child text blocks having their own coordinates.
LaTeX rendering requires the separate Math package and node registration.
Public SourceSpan and distinction between logical ActualText and block LayoutText.
Uses a full captured snapshot for background Markdig Parse; incremental document update publication is separate; producer activates with observers, UI-thread access required.

avalonia.fact: Official NuGet page verifies version exists and package targets net8.0/net10.0 with Avalonia and platform packages >=12.1.4. Package compatibility is not platform interaction acceptance.
